items.quote: She delivered her share of root cause analysis of recurring service failures reliably.
Nydre Wilira drove the policy review on housing grants for the whole division.
Nydre spearheaded analytics to guide resource allocation at the national level.
She took ownership of upholding governance and audit standards and steered it to completion.
Nydre Wilira headed adoption of new technology tools for case officers, setting priorities for several teams.
Nydre championed the crisis response to a major system outage and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
She set the direction for the organisational restructuring of the department across the public service.
